description: Part 2 §69 success criteria: the routine questions of an incident investigation, asked in ONE conversation with the incident on screen (incident_id, as the Iris drawer on an incident page sends it). What the query engine answers is scored; what it cannot answer yet must be refused honestly, naming the plan row that closes it — never answered with a broader or unrelated query
